THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
FANTASY & PERIOD
068
STUDY 121
Burgundy Velvet Jacket & Lace Jabot
Rights check
Source: 25016.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight dark hair
stands in a cemetery with blurred headstones behind
her. She wears a deep red velvet fitted jacket with a
black lace jabot, a black velvet high collar, and a wide
black belt. A gold cross pendant and a gold drop
earring complete the look. Her lips are a bold red. Her
expression is calm and serious, looking off to the side.
Soft, natural daylight. Palette of burgundy, black, and
aged gold. Dramatic and Victorian, in the style of a
gothic period portrait.
Dramatic, Victorian, elegant
WORKING NOTES
- The lace jabot and red velvet are the key contrasts.
- Keep the cemetery for a gothic, atmospheric setting.
